parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the bastion host on which you want to delete the user group.

> You can call the [DescribeInstances](~~153281~~) operation to query the ID of the bastion host.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the bastion host on which you want to delete the user group.

> For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see [Regions and zones](~~40654~~).

parameters.name: UserGroupId
parameters.description:
The ID of the user group that you want to delete.

> You can call the [ListUserGroups](~~204509~~) operation to query the ID of the user group.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun yundun-bastionhost delete-user-group --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --user-group-id '１' --region cn-hangzhou
